Repro: outer Dialog with a button that opens an inner Dialog; click it, press Escape, and the outer `onOpenChange` is called (`expected "spy" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times`). Fix: call `event.stopPropagation()` when the dialog handles Escape. [blocking] src/Tabs.tsx `syncTabs`: the auto-select of the first enabled tab runs only on the first TabList layout effect (`initialized` ref). An uncontrolled Tabs with no defaultValue whose tabs mount after the first render ends with nothing selected and every panel hidden. Repro: a wrapper rendering `{tabs.map(v => {v})}{tabs.map(v => {v})}`; render with tabs=[], rerender with tabs=["a","b"]; tab "a" has aria-selected="false". Fix: only set `initialized` once enabledValues.length > 0, so the first-enabled fallback runs when tabs first appear. Never override a valid existing selection. Add a test. 2. [blocking] src/Dialog.tsx `handleKeyDown`: React synthetic events bubble through portals along the React tree, so Escape in an inner Dialog (opened from a button inside an outer Dialog) also reaches the outer dialog's onKeyDown, and the outer onOpenChange(false) is called. Fix: when the dialog handles Escape, call event.preventDefault() and event.stopPropagation(). For Tab handling, return early if event.defaultPrevented or if event.target isn't DOM-contained in this dialog (`!dialogRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)`). Otherwise an outer dialog with zero tabbables pulls focus out of the inner dialog. Add tests: nested dialogs where Escape closes only the inner one (the outer spy is not called) and the outer stays open; nested dialogs where the outer has no tabbables besides the opener... make the outer content a button that opens the inner, and check that Tab and Shift+Tab inside the inner keep focus inside the inner. 3. [minor] Dialog: treat `description=""` like no description (no empty

Controlled (`value` given): displays `value` and only changes when the parent changes it; `onValueChange` is called in both modes on user selection. - T5 Roving tabindex: only the selected tab has `tabIndex=0`, all others `-1`.
